# TidyDisk: free disk cleaner for Mac developers

> TidyDisk finds the gigabytes hiding in Xcode DerivedData, node_modules, simulators, package-manager caches and forgotten projects, and cleans them safely.

Made by RiekApps (https://riekapps.com), an indie app studio. Open source: https://github.com/prateekcode/tidydisk

## Facts
- Free. Version 1.1, macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel (universal), notarized by Apple.
- Install: download https://tidydisk.riekapps.com/TidyDisk-1.1.zip, or `brew install --cask prateekcode/tap/tidydisk`.
- 100% on-device: no account, no telemetry; no data is collected or transmitted.
- Smart Scan detects the developer tools actually installed (Xcode, npm, CocoaPods, Gradle, Docker, Homebrew) and scans only those.
- Space Lens for projects: finds every project and what its build artifacts weigh; clean node_modules and build folders, or archive whole projects to GitHub or iCloud first.
- Large files and duplicates: surfaces forgotten multi-gigabyte files and duplicate downloads. Deletions go to the Trash.
- Lives in the menu bar: free space at a glance, one-click scans, optional weekly scan with a notification.
- Three safety tiers: safe caches are pre-selected; aggressive and "nuclear" options (such as deleting all node_modules) always need an explicit opt-in.
- Native SwiftUI app, a few megabytes on disk (not Electron).
